standing.title: Whitney Museum free Friday evening
standing.description: The Whitney is free to all every Friday evening from 5 to 10pm, and also on the second Sunday of each month.
standing.time_note: Free admission Fridays 5-10pm. Free tickets are limited and released in advance.
standing.practical_note: Reserve the free timed ticket ahead; walk-up availability runs out on busy evenings.
standing.date_idea_reason: Free evening museum hours next to the High Line and a dense stretch of bars, so the museum is the anchor rather than the whole plan.
standing.why_now: A standing free window that makes a good anchor for a Friday evening in the Meatpacking District.

standing.title: Whitney Museum free second Sunday
standing.description: The Whitney offers free admission to everyone on the second Sunday of every month.

standing.why_now: Falls in this window and only comes around once a month.

holiday_plan.intro: Veterans Day is Wednesday, not an automatic long weekend; confirm your own time off. These five options stay within roughly three hours' driving distance in normal traffic, not a holiday-traffic guarantee. Day trips fit November 11; the overnight requires an optional November 10 evening departure outside the stated window.

trips.title: Cold Spring waterfront and Hudson Highlands
trips.why: Combine Main Street browsing and lunch with the Hudson waterfront and, conditions permitting, a walk at Little Stony Point. This is a nature-and-village outing rather than a demanding summit hike.
trips.transport: Car-free: Metro-North Hudson Line from Grand Central to Cold Spring, then walking. Use Cold Spring station, not the closed Breakneck Ridge station.
trips.time_budget: A full day with a daylight walking portion; check the actual outbound and return trains.
trips.booking_note: The preserve is open sunrise to sunset. Breakneck Ridge, its station and some adjoining trails are closed for construction. Consult the official trail map and current closures; individual shops and restaurants need separate Wednesday-hours checks.

trips.title: Hudson design stay and Olana's landscape
trips.why: Stay on Warren Street, then explore the landscape Frederic Church designed at Olana during his bicentenary year. The attraction on this date is the grounds, not the house interior.
trips.transport: Car-required for this combined itinerary: drive to Hudson and between town and Olana. A town-only Hudson stay can instead use Amtrak, but Olana needs a separately arranged transfer.
trips.time_budget: Optional November 10 overnight, November 11 sightseeing and return. Olana estimates 2.5 hours driving from NYC before traffic.
trips.booking_note: Olana's grounds are free and open daily, 8 a.m. to sunset. The house is closed November 2–15, and landscape tours in that period run only on weekends. Rivertown Lodge is a researched lodging option, not verified availability; its Pez restaurant normally closes Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Check room cancellation terms and arrange another dinner option.

trips.title: Storm King sculpture landscape — conditional
trips.why: A substantial outdoor-art day among large-scale sculptures and rolling terrain, without adding a second destination.
trips.transport: Car-required for the itinerary proposed here. Storm King also lists Coach USA packages and rail-plus-car connections, but November 11 bus service was not verified; a train alone does not reach the entrance.
trips.time_budget: A full day, allowing several daylight hours on the grounds and a traffic buffer.
trips.booking_note: Current general hours include Wednesdays, 10 a.m.–6 p.m., with final entry at 5 p.m. However, the ticket page still advertises October tickets: November 11 opening hours and ticket inventory remain unconfirmed. Retain this option only after the date is confirmed. Advance tickets are recommended; the outdoor museum operates rain or shine.

trips.title: Philadelphia's Veterans Day stories and market lunch
trips.destination: Old City and Reading Terminal Market, Philadelphia
trips.why: The Museum of the American Revolution has a confirmed November 11 program, including a Louis Cook talk and a theatrical portrayal of soldier Joseph Plumb Martin. Pair it with Reading Terminal Market for a food-focused stop during America's 250th-anniversary year.
trips.transport: Car-free: Amtrak from New York Penn/Moynihan to Philadelphia's 30th Street Station, then SEPTA and walking. Exact trains and fares were not verified because Amtrak's page was blocked.
trips.time_budget: A full day with an early departure; prioritize the museum and market rather than several major museums.
trips.booking_note: Museum hours are 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; the November 11 performances are listed for 1:15 and 3:15 p.m. General admission offers an undated ticket option. Holiday free admission applies only to specified military, veteran and Blue Star Family visitors and is obtained in person; do not assume eligibility. The market lists 8 a.m.–6 p.m., with individual merchant hours varying.

trips.title: Bayard Cutting Arboretum and café
trips.why: A landscaped nature outing with specimen trees and a café stop, rather than a beach-season itinerary. Suitable for unhurried walking without promising peak foliage.
trips.transport: Car-free: LIRR to Great River, followed by the arboretum's published approximately three-quarter-mile walk. Driving is optional; assess the station-to-entrance walking route for your mobility needs.
trips.time_budget: A daylight day trip planned around the 4 p.m. winter closing and the return train.
trips.booking_note: Published winter hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m. The café normally opens Tuesday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m.; confirm holiday service, and reserve Victorian tea separately if desired. Public house tours are Thursday–Sunday, so do not expect one on Wednesday. Picnicking is prohibited. Drivers should verify current holiday parking charges because the fee page includes older dates.

local_ideas.why: The organizer confirms the parade on Fifth Avenue, with astronaut and Navy veteran Sunita Williams as 2026 grand marshal. Use public transit; the retrieved page did not establish the start time, detailed route or spectator access arrangements.

local_ideas.title: Intrepid Museum history-and-space day
local_ideas.why: Explore the aircraft carrier and Space Shuttle Pavilion. Published fall holiday hours are 10 a.m.–5 p.m., last entry 4 p.m.; check timed admission and exhibit closures. This recommendation is for a museum visit, not an unverified commemorative ceremony.

local_ideas.title: Governors Island walking escape
local_ideas.why: Take a car-free harbor outing for landscape walks and views. Current fall island hours are 7 a.m.–6 p.m. Use the Manhattan ferry or separately verify NYC Ferry: the Trust's seasonal Brooklyn service ends November 1. Check the day's return service and food-vendor openings.
